```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# ==========================================
# Helper Function: Clean Numeric Strings
# ==========================================
def clean_census_numbers(series):
    # Remove '$', '%', ',', and spaces, then convert to float for machine learning
    s = series.astype(str).str.replace(r'[\$,% ]', '', regex=True)
    # Replace Census '-' or 'N' (missing data) with NaN
    s = s.replace(['-', 'N', '(X)'], np.nan)
    return pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')

# ==========================================
# 1. Clean DP05 (Demographics - Median Age)
# ==========================================
print("Processing DP05 (Demographics)...")
df_dp05_raw = pd.read_csv("raw-data/ACSDP5Y2023.DP05-2026-03-07T171416.csv")

# Set "Label (Grouping)" as the index and transpose so counties become rows
df_dp05_raw.set_index(df_dp05_raw.columns[0], inplace=True)
df_dp05 = df_dp05_raw.T.reset_index()
df_dp05.rename(columns={'index': 'Raw_County'}, inplace=True)

# We only need the "!!Estimate" rows to get the raw Median Age (not percentages)
df_dp05_est = df_dp05[df_dp05['Raw_County'].str.contains('!!Estimate')].copy()

# Create 'Merge_Name' to perfectly match your main dataframe (e.g., "Adams County..." -> "adams")
df_dp05_est['Merge_Name'] = df_dp05_est['Raw_County'].str.split('!!').str[0]
df_dp05_est['Merge_Name'] = df_dp05_est['Merge_Name'].str.replace(" County, Illinois", "", regex=False).str.lower().str.replace(" ", "").str.replace(".", "", regex=False)

# Dynamically find the exact column containing "Median age"
age_col = [col for col in df_dp05_est.columns if 'Median age' in str(col)][0]

# Extract, clean, and format
df_clean_dp05 = df_dp05_est[['Merge_Name', age_col]].copy()
df_clean_dp05.rename(columns={age_col: 'Median_Age'}, inplace=True)
df_clean_dp05['Median_Age'] = clean_census_numbers(df_clean_dp05['Median_Age'])

# Save to a new CSV file
df_clean_dp05.to_csv("derived-data/Cleaned_DP05_Age.csv", index=False)
print(f"✅ Saved Cleaned_DP05_Age.csv successfully! ({len(df_clean_dp05)} counties)")


# ==========================================
# 2. Clean DP03 (Economics - Income, Labor, Mfg)
# ==========================================
print("\nProcessing DP03 (Economics)...")
df_dp03_raw = pd.read_csv("raw-data/ACSDP5Y2023.DP03-2026-03-07T170912.csv")

# Transpose the data
df_dp03_raw.set_index(df_dp03_raw.columns[0], inplace=True)
df_dp03 = df_dp03_raw.T.reset_index()
df_dp03.rename(columns={'index': 'Raw_County'}, inplace=True)

# Split into Estimate (for absolute Income $) and Percent (for Labor/Mfg %)
df_dp03_est = df_dp03[df_dp03['Raw_County'].str.contains('!!Estimate')].copy()
df_dp03_pct = df_dp03[df_dp03['Raw_County'].str.contains('!!Percent')].copy()

# Create 'Merge_Name'
df_dp03_est['Merge_Name'] = df_dp03_est['Raw_County'].str.split('!!').str[0].str.replace(" County, Illinois", "", regex=False).str.lower().str.replace(" ", "").str.replace(".", "", regex=False)

# Dynamically find target columns
income_col = [col for col in df_dp03_est.columns if 'Median household income' in str(col)][0]
lfpr_col = [col for col in df_dp03_pct.columns if 'In labor force' in str(col)][0]
mfg_col = [col for col in df_dp03_pct.columns if 'Manufacturing' in str(col)][0]

# Assemble the final clean economic dataset
df_clean_dp03 = pd.DataFrame({'Merge_Name': df_dp03_est['Merge_Name'].values})
df_clean_dp03['Median_Income'] = clean_census_numbers(df_dp03_est[income_col].values)
df_clean_dp03['Labor_Force_Pct'] = clean_census_numbers(df_dp03_pct[lfpr_col].values)
df_clean_dp03['Manufacturing_Pct'] = clean_census_numbers(df_dp03_pct[mfg_col].values)

# Save to a new CSV file
df_clean_dp03.to_csv("derived-data/Cleaned_DP03_Econ.csv", index=False)
print(f"✅ Saved Cleaned_DP03_Econ.csv successfully! ({len(df_clean_dp03)} counties)")
```
